How it works

1. Pick your panels. Choose any of the seven ad panels: the upper and lower panels on the front, right and left, and the upper back.

2. Upload artwork. Add a JPG, PNG or WEBP for each panel and rotate the carton to check it.

3. Send it to AquaAd. Add your details and send. Our team reviews your design and gets back to you.

The lower back is reserved for AquaAd company information.

3D bottle preview

Tick the panels you want to advertise on, then upload artwork to each one. The back panel is reserved for AquaAd company information.
